title: The Island That Moved
logline: Young Sinbad sails from Baghdad, lands on a green island that turns out to be a sleeping whale, is left adrift on a plank, and finds his way home with his goods and a story.
moral: The sea hides wonders, and dangers the young do not yet know.
tone: Bright 80s adventure anime: sunny and funny, one real scare, one lonely stretch, a warm homecoming.

beats.summary: Sinbad loves the sea and does not see what moves under it.
Three chests sealed with his tangerine band and star: the object that will prove who he is.
A green island on a calm sunny morning.
The captain's spyglass: barnacles, and a shore that breathes.
Everything stops; under the water an eye opens.
The ground shakes and the water rises.
The back sinks, the fire dies, Sinbad is left behind.
He holds the plank with all his strength; the ship vanishes.
Real land: he knocks on it to be sure.
The king's crown jumps at the story.
His own chests on the deck of the arriving ship.
The sea hides wonders: far out, the island waves goodbye.

sets.description: harbourQuay (planned name), variant 'baghdad', 2200 x 1230, ground y 900. Painted plate: morning sky, tall clouds, a skyline of two domes (gold dome at x 520, top y 300), a minaret at x 760 (top y 220), flat roofs with washing lines, palms. Cel layer: warehouse wall x 0..420 (top y 380) with an arched door, awning stall at x 300 (Library marketStall), crates and barrels x 80..300, a bench at x 620..700, bollards at x 1000 and 1080, stone quay edge at x 1100, paving to y 1230. Right of x 1100 open water (water line y 930 at the wall, horizon y 640). Dhow berth x 1380..1900, deck y 800, gangplank (1100, 900) to (1400, 805). Repaint 'gold' for S18 (warm afternoon, long shadows to the left).

openSea (planned name). Looping 2400 x 1230 sea: sky plate (presets day, sunset, night, dawn, gold; cross-faded by a mix value), horizon y 600, four water layers: far y 600..700 (parallax 0.2), mid y 700..800 (0.45), ship line y 820 (1.0), front y 880..1230 (1.3, drawn over hulls and swimmers). One wave function seaY(x, t, layer, mood) gives the surface line for every floating thing. Moods: glass (amp 3), calm (6), swell (22), storm swell (60, with single big swells up to 180). Tall cumulus clouds on the horizon in every day sky (the series signature).

The top of the whale as a place, 1600 x 1230, built from the whale character's island dressing plus openSea layers: crown at (800, 880), shore at the water line y 960 at x 150 and x 1450 (island 1300 wide), sand rim 60 wide, grass, flowers, shells and stones along the rim, palms at x 520, 700, 1180 (Library palmTree h 300 to 360), bushes, the grey blowhole mound at x 230..330 (40 high, with barnacles). Far dhow on the horizon at x 260. The whole island takes rise (y offset), tilt and breathe from the whale's fields.

Cross-section view for the reveal (part of the openSea module): above the water line the normal sea and sky; below it a painted teal to deep blue gradient with slanting light shafts, drifting bubbles, a school of 14 small fish, sea grass at the very bottom. Used at scene scale 1.0 to 0.55 with the water line at world y 520 in the wide.

islandShore (planned name), 2000 x 1230, ground y 900. Sea x 0..820 (openSea layers), wet sand to x 900, cream beach to x 1500 with a tide line of shells, stones and seaweed, palms at x 1050, 1300, 1620, two grey rocks at x 1150 and x 1440, meadow beyond x 1500 with flowers, green hills, and a far palace with a gold dome at (1750, 380). Bright morning.

Library palaceHall, variant 'palace', wall 'paper' with warm trim; outside(ctx) draws the sea, a palm and a strip of sky in the door arch. Dressing added by the scene: two banners in emerald and gold, a bowl of fruit on a low table, floor cushions. Use the set's own anchors (dais, throne.sitY, door).

harbourQuay (planned name), variant 'island': the same geometry as baghdadQuay (edge x 1100, berth x 1380..1900) with a different painted plate and dressing: white walls with a blue door, green hill with the gold domed palace at (420, 330), six palms, fishing nets on poles, baskets of fish, a small skiff tied at x 1150, bright tropical morning.

actions.library: whale eye function (part of whale): lid, gaze, pupil; underSea plate

scenes.summary: The ground shakes under their feet and the water climbs the shore all round the island.

camera.notes: 41.2 back on the camp at zoom 1.25; panel only shake 41.6 to 42.6 (4 units, fading). 44.5 to 45.6 pull out to the full island wide {x 800, y 640, zoom 1.0}; 47.2 to 48.2 a slow pan from the left shore to the right shore and back to centre. No close-ups: the place is the subject.

scenes.composition: Same world. The water edge starts at x 150 and x 1450 and ends at x 330 and x 1270 (the shore foam line moves 180 units inward, the visible island shrinks from 1300 to 940 wide). Group retreats to x 700..900 on the crown.

actions.action: The ground dips a few units under them (the breath before the shake)
actions.acting: everyone's knees give a little; Sinbad's eyes go down
actions.library: island rise -6 by flow; sq 0.97

actions.action: The ground JOLTS: an impact frame with the chrome word RUMBLE!, the island jumps 14 units and tilts 2 degrees; everyone squashes and throws out their arms
actions.acting: impact frame 2 drawings, then panel only shake; each man staggers on a different beat; turbans and tails arrive late
actions.library: S.emphasis('RUMBLE!', {rect: panel}); impactSquash; lagged; PERSON_HANDS.armsOut

actions.action: The pot swings off its tripod and spills, the coconut rolls downhill, sparks jump from the fire
actions.acting: props react to the tilt with swing(t, 41.6, amp); the fat merchant grabs for the pot and misses
actions.library: swing; kfn roll with rot from distance

actions.action: Sinbad looks down at his own feet, lifts one, then the other, then lays his palm flat on the grass: the ground swells and sinks under his hand, slowly, like breathing
actions.acting: eyes down [0,1], brow -0.6 (worried); kneel 0.6; his hand rides the 8 unit rise and fall
actions.library: island rise = 8 * osc(t, 2.6); person kneel + handRW on the ground

actions.action: The fat merchant sits down hard and hugs a palm trunk; the plum one points at the ground with a shaking hand
actions.acting: tremble 2 units on both; mouths 'o'; the pointer looks from the ground to Sinbad and back
actions.library: tremble(tc, 2); PERSON_HANDS.pointDown; gazePlan

actions.action: Pull out to the whole island: a round green hill in a wide sea, the men small on its crown, the ship far off
actions.acting: small flat heroes in a huge painted world; cloud shadows slide over the water
actions.library: camera kfn; openSea layers behind and in front of the island

actions.action: The water climbs: the foam line creeps up both shores, covering shore stones, shells and the lowest flowers; a neon arrow points up at each end
actions.acting: foam edge advances in steps on threes (cel water), 180 units by 50.3
actions.library: whale rise by kfn (the island sinks 45 units in this scene) + shore foam band; S.arrow x2

actions.action: The beached skiffs lift off the sand, swing round and knock together
actions.acting: bob begins as they float; a loose oar slides overboard
actions.library: skiff y following the water line; swing

actions.action: Pan along the rim: water closing in from every side, a ring of foam
actions.acting: the pan shows the left shore, the crown with the group, the right shore
actions.library: camera pan; foam ring = two shore bands and front wave layer

actions.action: The four back uphill into a tight knot, back to back, each watching a different shore
actions.acting: out of step retreat (walk backwards); Sinbad's gaze darts left, right, down; he puts an arm across the plum merchant
actions.library: walk(xf, tc) with dir kept; gazePlan saccades; PERSON_HANDS.shield

actions.action: The water reaches the roots of the first palm; a fish jumps where the grass was a moment ago
actions.acting: silver fish arc, splash rings
actions.library: fish cel on hop arc; ripple

actions.action: Held fear: wide eyes, small trembles, a cold light band sweeping over the group
actions.acting: moving hold on twos: breathing, tremble, turban tails in the wind; nobody is frozen
actions.library: tremble + breathe + lightBands

actions.action: Pause: with a hiss the grey rock at the end of the island blows a jet of spray 220 units high; mist rains down on the men, who all turn to look
actions.acting: heads turn with blinks, one after another; turbans drip
actions.library: whale {spout: pulse(t, 51.2, 0.9)}; drops()

scenes.summary: The captain shouts from the ship: come back, that is no island. The camera sinks under the water and shows what it is: a huge sleeping whale, now awake and annoyed.

camera.notes: 52.21 the ship rail at zoom 1.3 (captain at panel x 380, island visible beyond at the right). 53.8 ease out to the wide zoom 1.0: ship left, island right. 57.7 to 58.9 the camera cranes DOWN: the waterline climbs from panel y 800 to y 330. 58.92 impact frame, then the scene group scales from 1.0 to 0.55 about the island so the whole whale fits (58.92 to 59.9).

scenes.composition: Above water: dhow at x 80..560, island cap at x 760..1500. Below water (scale 0.55 view): waterline at world y 520; the whale 1500 x 520 units at scale 0.55 = 825 x 286 on screen, head to the right, eye at about panel (800, 640), tail at the left under the ship. Balloons sit in the sky band and point at the captain.

actions.action: The spyglass drops on its cord; the captain fills his chest and cups both hands round his mouth
actions.acting: anticipation: shoulders up, lean back (tip -0.1) for 4 drawings before the shout
actions.library: anticipate; PERSON_HANDS.cupMouth both hands; swing for the glass

actions.action: He leans far over the rail and shouts; the sailors behind him turn their heads one after another
actions.acting: talk on threes, brow 0.8, turban tail and beard lag the lunge
actions.library: talk = lip flap on celStep(t, 8); lagged; stagger

actions.action: Wide: ship on the left, the shrinking island on the right, sound arcs travelling from the captain across the water
actions.acting: the island men are small cels in a knot; water between them and the ship glitters
actions.library: soundArcs(ctx, x, y, 1, t); camera kfn

actions.action: Speech bubble COME BACK! He beckons with a full arm sweep, twice
actions.acting: arm sweep = big arc from pointing to his own chest; second sweep faster
actions.library: S.label('COME BACK!', ..., {balloon:true, to: captain head}); flow aR

actions.action: The bubble grows to COME BACK! QUICK! He stamps; two sailors run to ready a rope
actions.acting: stamp with a deck thump squash; sailors start on different drawings
actions.library: balloon text step; impactSquash small; walk

actions.action: He stabs a finger at the island and shakes his head hard
actions.acting: pointFwd held, head shake 3 swings with a blink, jewel flashing
actions.library: PERSON_HANDS.pointFwd; tilt flow

actions.action: New bubble: THAT IS NO ISLAND... On the island the small figures stop and turn toward the ship
actions.acting: the knot of men turns head first, then bodies (staggered)
actions.library: S.label balloon; stagger

actions.action: The camera begins to sink: the waterline rises through the frame, the island's shore passes, grey skin with barnacles appears where rock should be
actions.acting: slow and smooth (camera on ones); the beat of quiet before the reveal
actions.library: scene group translate by kfn; underSea plate slides in

actions.action: Below the surface: teal light shafts, a school of small fish, and a vast curved wall going down out of frame
actions.acting: fish school turns together but with per fish phase
actions.library: underSea plate + fish school (seeded)

actions.action: IMPACT FRAME, then the reveal: the island is the top of the back of an enormous whale. Bubble at the surface: IT IS A WHALE!
actions.acting: 2 drawing inverted flash with radial lines; then the held wide
actions.library: S.emphasis({rect: panel}); whale full body (new); S.label balloon to the captain

actions.action: Pull out until the whole animal fits: the island is a small green cap on its back, the dhow a toy above its tail; the fish school scatters
actions.acting: scale 1.0 to 0.55; fish scatter radially in 6 drawings
actions.library: scene scale by kfn about (1130, 820); fish stagger

actions.action: The whale is awake and groggy: heavy lid, a slow blink, then the eye rolls up toward the small orange glow on its back (the fire). Its brow lowers. The tail flexes once and a string of bubbles leaves its mouth
actions.acting: comic: annoyed sleeper. Lid 0.5, brow down, gaze up and back; tail flow, flukes lag
actions.library: whale {lid, gaze, brow, tail, bubbles}; small glow disc at the fire

scenes.summary: The merchants run for the boats, the water puts the fire out and the whale's back sinks. Sinbad, farthest from the boats, is left on the last hump.

camera.notes: 60.82 wide zoom 1.1 tracking the runners left to right (x 800 to 1250). 63.86 to 65.4 a medium on the fire {x 880, y 720, zoom 1.5} (the wave, the steam). 66.0 pull to the full wide zoom 1.0 for the sinking and hold on Sinbad small at the centre.

scenes.composition: Runners go from the crown (x 800) to the skiffs, now floating at x 1300. Sinbad starts at the far palm x 520 with an armful of wood. Water is ankle deep at x > 1100 from 61.5. The tail rises at x 100..330 from 66.98.

actions.action: The three merchants run for the skiffs, starting on different beats; water splashes at their ankles
actions.acting: fast run cycle (amp high, tip 0.18), robes hitched; small splashes on every footfall
actions.library: walk(xf, tc) fast + footfalls driving drops()/ripple; stagger(i)

actions.action: The fat merchant runs with the cooking pot on his head like a helmet; the plum one loses his turban, snatches it out of the air and keeps going
actions.acting: comic secondary action; the turban unrolls into a ribbon that follows him
actions.library: prop pinned to head anchor; ribbon on lagged

actions.action: At the far palm Sinbad, arms full of firewood, sees them go; he drops the wood and runs after them, a long way behind
actions.acting: double take with a blink, sticks fall (fallY, staggered), run starts with an anticipation step back
actions.library: anticipate; walk; sticks as small cels

actions.action: The merchants tumble into the skiffs; the boats rock hard; the sailors at the oars pull at once
actions.acting: each body landing dips the boat (spring), last man hauled in by his sash
actions.library: skiff bob spring per landing; PERSON_HANDS.reach

actions.action: A wave lip slides over the grass and into the fire: HISS! A column of steam, the flame shrinks to nothing
actions.acting: flame 1 to 0 in 6 drawings; steam ribbon widens; the warm rim light on nearby things goes out
actions.library: campfire {fire: 1 to 0, steam: 1}; steam()

actions.action: The black sticks float apart on the water; one ember blinks out
actions.acting: small and quiet; Sinbad runs past behind it, splashing knee deep
actions.library: sticks drifting on the wave line; glint fade

actions.action: The whole island tilts and starts down; the camera pulls out
actions.acting: tilt 4 degrees toward the head end; everything on it inherits the tilt
actions.library: whale {rise by kfn to -150, tilt}

actions.action: Wide: the green hill sinks. The palms go under one by one, crowns last, like the masts of a sinking ship
actions.acting: each palm leaves a ring of foam; fronds float for a moment
actions.library: palm clip at the water line; ripple per palm (stagger)

actions.action: At the far end a tail fluke as tall as the dhow's mast rises out of the sea, water sheeting off it
actions.acting: slow, heavy rise (flow), fluke tips lag; the skiffs are already 300 units away
actions.library: whale {tail: 0 to 1}; drops in sheets (rect strips)

actions.action: Sinbad alone on the last hump of grass: water at his ankles, knees, waist. Arms out for balance, he looks at the skiffs, at the ship, at the water
actions.acting: wobble (tip osc), gaze plan skiff, ship, down; mouth set, not screaming
actions.library: seaClip at the water line; gazePlan; idle wobble

actions.action: Foam rings close round him as the last grass disappears
actions.acting: rings contract instead of expanding (reverse ripple)
actions.library: ripple with reversed u

actions.action: Pause: the fluke slaps down far behind him; a wall of spray
actions.acting: spray column, then drops; Sinbad's head turns to it with a blink
actions.library: whale tail 1 to 0; splash (new effect in the sea kit)

scenes.summary: Sinbad jumps and swims for the boat but cannot reach it. Half drowned, he sees a wooden plank floating near him.

camera.notes: 69.88 wide zoom 1.1 on the jump, the water line at panel y 800. 72.3 tracking right with the swimmer at zoom 1.2 (skiff ahead at the right third). 75.5 to 77.0 hold on Sinbad alone, then pan left to meet the plank entering from the left edge. Water fills the lower picture, so it is never empty.

scenes.composition: Swell mood: wave layers amplitude 22. Swimmer's head at y 790..830 riding the wave line. Skiff starts 260 units ahead and gains. The plank (240 x 34) enters from x -150 on the same wave line.

actions.action: He crouches on the vanishing hump and LEAPS toward the skiffs
actions.acting: anticipation crouch 5 drawings (sq 0.82), stretch 1.12 on take off, arms thrown forward
actions.library: anticipate + hop(t, ...); sq

actions.action: In the air: body stretched, turban tail trailing, a shadow racing over the water under him
actions.acting: hanging feet, the shadow shrinks at the top of the arc
actions.library: groundShadow(ctx, x, waterY, w, lift, {flat:true})

actions.action: SPLASH! A crown of water, rings, drops; he is gone for four drawings
actions.acting: splash crown on threes; chrome word SPLASH! above the crown, not over him
actions.library: splash effect (new, sea kit) + ripple + drops; S.label('SPLASH!')

actions.action: He comes up, shakes the water off and swims hard after the skiff
actions.acting: head shake with a blink; crawl strokes alternate on twos, head tipped forward, the body clipped at the wave line
actions.library: swim pose (new): person clipped by seaClip, aL/aR crawl cycle 0.8 s, tip 0.25; drops()

actions.action: The skiff is being dragged away by the whale's swirl; a sailor in the stern stretches an oar back toward him
actions.acting: sailor leans out so far the others hold his sash; all four in the boat look back at Sinbad
actions.library: skiff x by kfn (gains 200 units); PERSON_HANDS.reach; lookAt

actions.action: Sinbad's hand reaches for the oar blade and closes on water, a hand's width short; a neon arrow marks the gap, then the gap doubles
actions.acting: reach with fingers arriving late; wet eyes; the miss is held 4 drawings
actions.library: handRW toward the oar tip; S.arrow between hand and oar

actions.action: A swell lifts the skiff, tips it over the crest and it slides down the far side: only the oar tips show, then nothing
actions.acting: the swell is a front wave layer rising 120 units across the frame
actions.library: openSea {swell at x(t)}; skiff clipped by the front layer

actions.action: A wave breaks over him. Only bubbles for six drawings. He comes up coughing, eyes shut
actions.acting: head back, mouth open, arms slapping; the low point of the film
actions.library: seaClip; bubbles; mouth 'open', lid 1

actions.action: From the left edge a wooden plank rides in on a swell, already moving, turning slowly
actions.acting: the prop enters moving; it rides the same wave line as he does
actions.library: plank (new prop) at seaY(x, t) with rot from the wave slope

actions.action: His eyes open, dart twice and lock on the plank; brows go up
actions.acting: saccades (2 drawing snaps), then a held stare; blink
actions.library: gazePlan(t, plan, 0.07); brow -0.7

actions.action: The plank passes close to camera: wood grain, two nail heads, a frayed rope end trailing
actions.acting: light glints along its wet top edge
actions.library: plank {rope: ribbon}; highlight strip

actions.action: It floats just out of reach, bobbing, drifting a little farther with each wave
actions.acting: tantalising: two waves, two small retreats
actions.library: kfn x with wave steps

actions.action: Three last strokes, each shorter and slower than the one before
actions.acting: tired: stroke period stretches 0.8, 1.0, 1.3 s; head lower each time
actions.library: crawl cycle with a slowing phase function

scenes.summary: He clings to the plank with all his strength and watches the ship disappear behind tall waves.

camera.notes: 80.48 medium wide zoom 1.3 on Sinbad and the plank. 82.0 to 82.7 push to a close-up zoom 2.3 on his face and hands (a real peak: 1.6 s only), back out by 83.6 to an over the shoulder wide zoom 1.0: Sinbad small at lower left (panel x 250, y 850), the ship on the horizon at upper right.

scenes.composition: Late afternoon sky repaint: gold and peach with blue above, the sea still blue green with gold crests (not monochrome). Ship on the horizon at panel (720, 610), 90 wide. Foreground swells rise to panel y 520 to hide it.

actions.action: He lunges and throws both arms over the plank; it dips under his weight and springs back
actions.acting: the plank sinks 20 units and rebounds (spring); his chin hits the wood
actions.library: handLW/handRW on the plank; rebound; seaClip

actions.action: He drags his chest onto it and lays his cheek on the wet wood, panting
actions.acting: breathing fast (breathe amp 0.04), lid 0.7, turban tail floating beside him
actions.library: person tip 0.5 over the plank; breathe

actions.action: Close-up: fingers locked over the plank's edge, teeth set, eyes wet and fierce
actions.acting: the hands are the subject: knuckles as hard highlight shapes; two light bands sweep the held drawing
actions.library: close-up of the Library head and hands at zoom 2.3; wet:true; brow 0.7; lightBands

actions.action: A wave washes right over plank and man. When it clears he is still there, blinking the water off
actions.acting: front wave layer wipes the frame in 5 drawings; drops off his chin
actions.library: openSea front layer swell; drops; blink

actions.action: He lifts his head and looks to the horizon
actions.acting: head up with a blink, gaze far right; the camera pulls out with his look
actions.library: lookAt horizon; camera kfn

actions.action: Far off, the dhow in the gold light, sail full, the skiffs being hauled up its side
actions.acting: tiny cels: two dots climbing a rope ladder; the captain's turban a white dot at the stern, facing back
actions.library: dhow at s 0.18 on the far wave layer

actions.action: The ship gets smaller in three held steps. Sinbad raises one arm and waves, mouth open in a shout nobody hears
actions.acting: the wave is wide at first, then slower; no balloon
actions.library: dhow s 0.18, 0.13, 0.09 on held steps; PERSON_HANDS.wave with aR flow

actions.action: A tall swell rises across the foreground and hides the ship
actions.acting: the swell lifts Sinbad 60 units as it passes under him
actions.library: openSea swell(x, t) amplitude 180 on the front layers

actions.action: The swell passes: the ship is smaller. A second, taller swell rises
actions.acting: his waving arm is lower now
actions.library: second swell; flow on aR

actions.action: The second swell passes: the horizon is empty. His arm comes down slowly, the hand last
actions.acting: follow through by delay on the hand; head drops onto the plank
actions.library: lagged; drop

actions.action: Pause: one small figure on a plank in a very large sea; a band of sunset light moves across the water
actions.acting: moving hold: bob, breathing, turban tail
actions.library: lightBands on the sea; idleSway

scenes.summary: Night on the plank until the wind drops; then the sky turns to morning.

camera.notes: Wide zoom 1.05, slow drift right 60 units over the scene. The plank rides at panel x 420..520, y 800. The night is repainted light and warm: lilac blue sky, big cream moon, peach glow on the horizon, blue green water with a cream moon path.

scenes.composition: Moon at panel (720, 260), r 70. Moon path a column of broken cream dashes from the horizon to the plank. Windy first half: whitecaps and spray streaks from the left. 93.98 to 95.6 the sky cross-fades to dawn and bright morning; the sun rises at panel (760, 560).

actions.action: Night: the sea under a big moon; wind streaks and whitecaps; the plank climbs and drops over long swells
actions.acting: colour stays varied: skin, tangerine turban and white tunic keep their own colours, with only a cool rim light
actions.library: openSea {sky:'night', mood:'swell'}; castFinish {rim:'#bfd8ff'}

actions.action: Sinbad lies along the plank on his front, one arm round it, the other trailing in the water
actions.acting: lid 0.8, slow heavy breathing; the trailing hand drags a small wake
actions.library: person lie:1 on the plank (rot with the wave slope); breathe

actions.action: A gust: spray streaks cross the frame, the plank tops a crest
actions.acting: plank bob amplitude 60; his turban tail whips
actions.library: speed line streaks in white; ribbon

actions.action: He starts to slide off on the far side of the crest, wakes with a jolt and grips again
actions.acting: eyes snap open, grab with both arms, a blink, then the lids sink again
actions.library: lid flow; handLW/handRW

actions.action: The streaks thin out; the clouds slide off the moon
actions.acting: wind streak count 12 to 0; cloud plates part
actions.library: kfn on streak count; cloud parallax

actions.action: The wind drops: the swells flatten, the whitecaps go, and the broken moon path joins into one clean column of light
actions.acting: wave amplitude 60 to 8 over 1.2 s; the plank's bob eases with it
actions.library: openSea mood blend swell to calm; moonReflection (planned name)

actions.action: He lets out a long breath and his eyes close; a sea turtle surfaces beside the plank, looks at him and goes under again
actions.acting: one visible exhale (sq 1.03 to 0.97); the turtle is a 1 s cameo
actions.library: turtle (Library) {ph, ext}; ripple

actions.action: The sky pales: lilac to peach to bright blue; the stars go out, the sun's edge lifts at the horizon
actions.acting: a 1.6 s repaint cross-fade on the plates only
actions.library: openSea sky mix night to dawn to day

actions.action: Morning. A gull lands on the end of the plank and pecks at it: land is near
actions.acting: the plank tips a little under the gull; Sinbad does not wake
actions.library: bird {kind:'dove'} landing (hop + landSquash); plank rot

scenes.summary: The waves carry him onto a real shore. He checks that it is real land, and falls asleep.

camera.notes: 95.66 tracking right with the plank at zoom 1.1 from open water (x 300) to the beach (x 900). 97.7 hold a wide {x 980, y 660, zoom 1.15}. 100.5 slow drift up and right to show the meadow, three grazing horses and a palace on the hill.

scenes.composition: World 2000 wide: sea x 0..820, wet sand to x 900, beach to x 1500, meadow beyond; palms at x 1050, 1300, 1620; rocks and shells along the tide line; far palace with a gold dome at x 1750, y 380. Sinbad comes to rest at x 960, y 900.

actions.action: The waves carry the plank toward a wide beach: palms, rocks, green hills
actions.acting: the gull rides the plank like a figurehead, then flies ahead
actions.library: openSea layers + islandShore plate, camera track

actions.action: One long wave lifts him and surfs the plank forward
actions.acting: the plank tilts nose down; his arms tighten
actions.library: swell(x, t) carrying the plank; rot

actions.action: The surf sets him down on the sand; the water slides back and leaves him and the plank behind a line of foam
actions.acting: foam line advances 120 units and retreats on threes; wet sand darkens and dries
actions.library: shore foam band; person lie:1 face down pose (lie with head toward the land)

actions.action: He lifts his head, pats the sand, then knocks on it twice with his knuckles and puts an ear to the ground. Nothing moves. Tag: REAL LAND
actions.acting: comic callback to the whale: suspicious squint, knock knock, listening pause, then relief
actions.library: kneel 0.5; handRW knock (2 quick dips); PERSON_HANDS.cupEar; S.label + S.arrow at the sand

actions.action: A huge smile, and his arms give way: he drops flat and is asleep before he lands
actions.acting: collapse in 4 drawings with a small bounce; lid 1
actions.library: lie:1; impactSquash small

actions.action: Z Z Z drifts up; his back rises and falls; the surf tickles his feet and his toes twitch; a gull stands on his back
actions.acting: breathing is big and slow; nothing else is still either: palms, foam, clouds
actions.library: zzz(); breathe; bird idle

actions.action: The camera drifts up from the sleeper: a meadow, three fine horses grazing, and a palace with a gold dome on the hill
actions.acting: horses in three coats graze out of sync (headDown, chew, tail swish)
actions.library: horse {headDown:1, chew, saddle:false, pal} x3 with the story's coat table

scenes.summary: The king's horse keepers find him and give him water and food.

camera.notes: 101.2 wide zoom 1.05 as the grooms and horses come down the beach from the right; 102.7 ease to {x 1040, y 680, zoom 1.3}: Sinbad, the kneeling groom and the lead horse's head; 104.2 pan right 200 units to take in all three horses and the second groom, back by 105.5. Ground at panel y 880.

scenes.composition: Sinbad at x 960. Groom A kneels at x 1060; lead horse (white, royal blue cloth with a gold crown mark) at x 1220 facing left; groom B with the bay and the black at x 1400..1560.

actions.action: Two grooms come along the beach leading three horses, already walking
actions.acting: horses walk with heads nodding out of step; groom B whistles (no sound), groom A swings a waterskin
actions.library: walk + GAIT.horse; horse pal table (white, bay, black lifted); person {costume:'servant', pal: GROOM[i]}

actions.action: The white horse stops, ears forward, lowers its head and sniffs the sleeper's turban; its snort blows the turban tail
actions.acting: ears first, then the head (ears lead the look); the gull on Sinbad's back flies off
actions.library: horse {earL, earR, headDown flow, snort}; ribbon kick

actions.action: Groom A starts, runs the last steps and drops to his knees beside Sinbad; groom B holds the other horses back
actions.acting: startle (sq 0.9, brows up) then quick walk; kneel with a hand on Sinbad's shoulder
actions.library: anticipate; walk; kneel:1; handRW

actions.action: Groom B calms the bay with a hand on its neck and a brush along its flank; tails swish
actions.acting: the men who look after horses, shown by their hands
actions.library: handRW along the flank (flow); horse tailSwish

actions.action: Pan over the three horses: each wears a royal blue cloth with a gold crown mark. Tag: THE KING'S HORSES. The white one tosses its head
actions.acting: label sits above the horses' backs, clear of every face
actions.library: horse {cloth, trim}; S.label; crown mark as a small celShade shape on the cloth

actions.action: Groom A nods toward the palace on the hill; its gold dome glints
actions.acting: a head tilt and a thumb over the shoulder
actions.library: glint at the dome; PERSON_HANDS.pointUp variant

actions.action: He lifts Sinbad to sitting, an arm behind his back; Sinbad's eyes open a crack
actions.acting: weight: Sinbad's head lolls and comes up late (lagged); lid 0.8 to 0.4
actions.library: person lie 1 to sit 1 blend; lagged head

actions.action: The waterskin is at his lips: three big gulps, a drop running down his chin, his eyes opening wider with each
actions.acting: gulp = small head tip back and throat bob on threes
actions.library: waterskin (planned name) {tilt, squeeze}; drops

actions.action: Bread and dates on a tray: he bites, cheeks full, hand to chest in thanks. The white horse leans over his shoulder and takes a date
actions.acting: chew cheek puffs alternate; he and the horse look at each other, a beat, and he gives it another
actions.library: foodTray (planned name); horse {chew}; lookAt both ways

actions.action: Pause: the horse chews with its lip curling; groom A laughs with his head back
actions.acting: three different laughs and chews on different periods
actions.library: horse chew; person mouth 'open' + sq pulse

scenes.summary: The king welcomes the strange guest and listens to his story in amazement.

camera.notes: Wide of the whole hall {x 500, y 640, zoom 1.0} with a slow drift toward the dais; 112.0 ease to zoom 1.2 centred between Sinbad and the king so both faces and the story balloon fit. No close-up.

scenes.composition: Library palaceHall (variant 'palace'): door arch at the left showing the sea and a palm, throne on the dais at the right (anchors from the set). King at the throne then at x 600; Sinbad at x 380 facing right; vizier at x 760, two guards at x 880 and x 150. Story balloon at panel (400, 300), 360 x 240.

subtitles.ar: كان السندباد شابًا يحب البحر، لكنه يجهل أخطاره. جمع بضاعته، | وودع أهله في بغداد، ثم ركب سفينة تجارية.
subtitles.en: Sinbad loved the sea but knew little of its dangers. He gathered his goods, | said goodbye to his family in Baghdad, and boarded a merchant ship.

subtitles.ar: سارت السفينة أيامًا في بحر هادئ. | وفي صباح مشمس، رأى البحارة جزيرة خضراء، فنزل بعضهم ليستريح وبقي القبطان يراقب البحر.
subtitles.en: The ship sailed for days on a calm sea. | One sunny morning, the sailors saw a green island. Some went ashore to rest while the captain watched the sea.

subtitles.ar: جلس السندباد مع رفاقه قرب الأشجار، | وأشعلوا نارًا ليعدوا الطعام. فجأة اهتزت الأرض تحت أقدامهم، | وبدأت المياه تتصاعد حول أطراف الجزيرة على نحو مخيف.
subtitles.en: Sinbad sat with his companions near the trees, | and they lit a fire to cook. Suddenly the ground shook beneath them, | and water began rising frighteningly around the edges of the island.

subtitles.ar: صاح القبطان من السفينة: «عودوا بسرعة! | هذه ليست جزيرة، بل حوت ضخم نائم!» | ركض التجار نحو القوارب، وانطفأت النار حين بدأ ظهر الحوت يغوص في الماء.
subtitles.en: The captain shouted from the ship, “Come back quickly! | That is not an island, but a huge sleeping whale!” | The merchants ran toward the boats, and the fire went out as the whale’s back began to sink.

subtitles.ar: قفز السندباد في البحر، لكنه لم يصل إلى القارب. | وجد لوحًا خشبيًا يطفو بالقرب منه، فتعلق به بكل قوته، | وشاهد السفينة تبتعد وراء الأمواج العالية.
subtitles.en: Sinbad jumped into the sea but could not reach a boat. | He found a wooden plank floating nearby, clung to it with all his strength, | and watched the ship disappear behind tall waves.

subtitles.ar: ظل السندباد فوق اللوح حتى هدأت الريح. | وفي الصباح حملته الأمواج إلى شاطئ حقيقي، فنام من التعب. | ثم وجده رجال يعتنون بخيول الملك، وأعطوه ماء وطعامًا.
subtitles.en: Sinbad stayed on the plank until the wind calmed. | In the morning, the waves carried him to a real shore, where he fell asleep from exhaustion. | The king’s horse keepers found him and gave him food and water.

subtitles.ar: رحب الملك بالضيف الغريب، وسمع قصته بدهشة. وبعد أيام وصلت سفينة تجارية إلى الميناء، | فعرف السندباد قبطانها، ورأى على ظهرها الصناديق التي تركها عند الرحيل.
subtitles.en: The king welcomed the strange guest and listened to his story in amazement. Days later, | a merchant ship arrived. Sinbad recognized its captain and saw the chests he had left aboard.

subtitles.ar: أعاد القبطان بضاعة السندباد، وساعده الملك على العودة إلى بغداد. احتضن أهله، | وحكى لهم قصة الجزيرة، وعرف أن البحر يخفي عجائب.
subtitles.en: The captain returned Sinbad’s goods, and the king helped him reach Baghdad. Sinbad embraced his family, | told them about the island, and learned that the sea held many wonders.

new_assets.name: whale
new_assets.description: Giant whale that passes for an island. 1500 x 520 at s 1, origin at the top of the back. Fields: s, rise (y offset of the whole animal against the water line), tilt, breathe, lid 0..1, gaze, brow, tail 0..1 (fluke lifted out of the water), spout 0..1, bubbles, dress 0..1 (island dressing: sand rim, grass cap, 3 palms, bushes, flowers, blowhole mound), silhouette. Reusable for any sea monster, great fish or Jonah story; the series' closing image.
new_assets.implementation: Body outline as one closed polygon of about 40 points (rounded head to the right, belly curve, tail stock, two fluke lobes) filled with celShade (slate fill, darker shade crescent from below, light top highlight); belly as a second pale polygon with 7 groove lines; pectoral fin 260 x 90 on a flow driven angle; eye = circle r 26 with a heavy upper lid polygon (lid field), pupil by gaze; barnacles as seeded small celShade circles. Island dressing drawn on the back curve between x -650 and x 650: sand band, grass polygon, Library palmTree and bush, seeded flowers and stones (bake the static dressing once). Everything above the back inherits rise and tilt through one ctx transform. Water in front is the openSea front layer, so sinking needs no clip.

new_assets.name: dhow
new_assets.description: The series merchant ship with its skiff (planned names dhow; skiff is new). Dimensions in props. Deck anchors returned: bow, mid, stern, rail(x), masthead, gangplank ends.
new_assets.implementation: Hull = polygon with a curved keel line (celShade, teak), turquoise band and cream strake as inner strips; stern cabin box with a small arched window; mast and yard as seg lines; sail = triangle whose trailing edge is a quadratic bulge driven by billow, stripes clipped to the sail; furled state = the same polygon scaled toward the yard by sail. Pitch and bob through one transform about the water line; people on deck are drawn inside that transform and clipped at the rail line. Skiff = small hull polygon, oars as two segs rotating on phase with a blade ellipse.

new_assets.name: openSea
new_assets.description: The sea grammar for the whole series (planned name openSea, with the underSea cross-section, the shore foam band and the sea kit helpers seaY, seaClip, splash, swell). See sets for layers and moods.
new_assets.implementation: Sky plates baked per preset with soft gradients and blurred cumulus (as ALI-01 abGrad / abCloud); cross-fade two plates by alpha. Each water layer is a polygon under the line seaY(x, t, layer, mood) = base + amp * (sin(k1 x + w1 t) + 0.5 sin(k2 x - w2 t)), filled flat (far turquoise #7fd6d8 to near cobalt #1f5fc0) with a hard lighter crest strip 10 units under the line and seeded white foam dashes that step on threes. swell(x, t) adds a travelling raised cosine bump. seaClip(ctx, layer, t) clips to above the line so swimmers and sinking things need no masks. splash = 7 tapered drops on parabolas plus a crown polygon for 6 drawings. Layers slide with camX for parallax; the pattern period is 600 so the strip loops.

new_assets.name: harbourQuay
new_assets.description: Planned name. One quay geometry with two plates: 'baghdad' (S1, S2, S18, and every later Sinbad departure and return) and 'island' (S15 to S17). Dimensions in sets.
new_assets.implementation: Painted skyline plate baked once per variant (domes as ellipses and arcs, minaret as stacked rects, palms from Library palmTree, soft blur 1 to 2 px); quay wall, paving joints, bollards and dressing as flat cels (Library marketStall and townProp for the stall, crates, barrels and baskets); water from openSea clipped to x > 1100.

new_assets.name: islandShore
new_assets.description: Planned name. Beach strip with sea, palms, rocks, meadow and a far palace; reusable for SIND-02's wooded island and SIND-06's narrow beach with other dressing.
new_assets.implementation: Sand as a polygon with a soft gradient plate under it, tide line props seeded (shells = small celShade fans, stones as ALI-01 abStone), Library palmTree, hill bands, palace as a small flat cel group; shore foam band = openSea helper moving along the beach slope on threes.

new_assets.name: swim and cling (person in water)
new_assets.description: A person in the sea: upright body clipped at the wave line (seaClip), crawl arm cycle on aL/aR with a period field, head tipped forward; cling = chest over the plank with both hands on world targets; lie along the plank uses the Library lie pose rotated to the wave slope.
new_assets.implementation: No new drawing: person(ctx, P) inside seaClip, P.y = seaY(x, t) + 120 * s so the water sits at chest height, aL/aR from a two key cycle sampled on twos, drops() at each hand entry.

new_assets.name: small props (chest with band and seal, campfire with cookPot, plank, spyglass, waterskin, foodTray)
new_assets.description: Six small flat props; chest, cookPot, waterskin, foodTray and giftChest reuse planned names. Sizes in props.
new_assets.implementation: Each is one function of 5 to 12 celShade shapes with coloured outlines; fire flame = 4 polygon drawings picked by Math.floor(celStep(t, 8) * 8) % 4 scaled by fire; smoke and steam as ribbons on a travelling sine.

owner_questions: The film ends on THE END although the series continues; default THE END (alternative: a NEXT VOYAGE... card).
The opening title shows the English title in chrome with one Arabic line, the script's own word for Sinbad, in Lalezar; no Arabic episode title was supplied, so none is invented (default).
Added foreshadowing not in the script: a whale shaped shadow passes under the quay in S1, and a small green hump waves its tail on the horizon in the last shot (default: keep both).
Added family members for the two family scenes: a mother, a father and a little sister (the script says only 'his family'); default as described.
The whale wakes because of the cooking fire (the traditional reason, not stated in this script) and is played as a grumpy sleeper, not a monster; default: keep, with no one harmed on screen.
English speech bubbles for the captain's line are shortened: COME BACK! QUICK! / THAT IS NO ISLAND... / IT IS A WHALE!; plus the invented reaction SINBAD?! ALIVE?! at 128.55 (default: keep).
Comic additions: Sinbad knocks on the real shore to check it (98.34), a horse steals a date (107.1), the king's crown hops (113.92); default: keep.
Series look set here for SIND-02 and SIND-06: Sinbad in a white tunic, plum trousers and a tangerine turban and sash (his single accent colour); default as in the Series bible.
implementation_notes: Style cel-anime-80s: frame with S.background(ctx, W, H, t, THEME.page) and S.box(ctx, 54, 54, 972, 1196, 1, THEME.panel); order per frame: sky plate, far sea, cels, front sea, light (glows, lightBands, castFinish rim), lettering, S.finish last.

Characters on twos: tc = celStep(t, THEME.celFps); blinks and lip flaps on celStep(t, 8). Camera, sea layer slides, light bands, glows and the CRT pass use t. Cel water (foam dashes, shore foam, fire, splash) steps on threes.

No colour model tint over the cast (owner direction): every time of day is a repainted plate; the cast keeps its colours and gets at most a rim light via castFinish. Night (S11) and gold afternoon (S10, S17, S18) must stay multi coloured.

Sinbad's palette constant SINBAD = {robe:'#f7f0e0', dot:'#cfc4b0', sleeve:'#f7f0e0', sleeveLen:'short', sash:'#ff7a1a', hc:'#ff7a1a', hd:'#c8520e', band:'#ffffff', pants:'#7b4bb0', head:'smallTurban', beard:'none', tache:false}. PEOPLE.dress spreads pal into the costume record, so head, beard, tache and sleeveLen can be overridden through pal; check a still first. If a field does not take, fall back to costume 'servant' with the same colours and draw the turban in the scene.
Every floating thing (dhow, skiff, plank, swimmer, sticks, gull on the plank) takes its y and tilt from the one function seaY(x, t, layer, mood); never animate a second bob by hand.

People on the dhow and in the skiffs are drawn inside the vessel's transform (pitch, bob) and clipped at the rail or gunwale; walking on the gangplank uses walk(xf, tc) along the plank line with footfalls bending the plank.

The reveal (57.68 to 60.82): draw sea and whale in one group transform G = translate + scale about (1130, 820); 57.68 to 58.9 translate up 470 units, 58.92 impact frame (S.emphasis with {rect: panel}, no word), 58.92 to 59.9 scale 1.0 to 0.55. Balloons are drawn outside G in panel space.

Whale island states: rise 0 (S3 to S5), breathing 8 units from 43.18, -45 by 50.3, -150 and tilt 4 degrees from 66.08, gone by 68.9. The shore foam line is where the back curve meets seaY, so the rising water needs no separate animation.

Speech is English balloons with S.label(ctx, text, x, y, p, {balloon:true, to:[x, y]}) pointing at the speaker, never over a face: LAND! 22.6; COME BACK! 54.58 growing to COME BACK! QUICK! 55.44; THAT IS NO ISLAND... 57.04; IT IS A WHALE! 58.92; SINBAD?! ALIVE?! 128.55. Tags (SINBAD, REAL LAND, THE KING'S HORSES, THE CAPTAIN!, HIS CHESTS) are plain S.label boxes with S.arrow where noted. Lettering total 18.

Transition: one tape transition S.transition(..., {rect: panel, caption:'DAYS LATER...'}) covering 114.5 to 115.6, silent (there is no pause there), set swap at its midpoint. Night to morning at 93.98 is a plate cross-fade, not a transition card.

Sound (8 effects, master 0.6, all in listed pauses or after the last word): whoosh 14.4 (sail), blip 31.1 (bubbles), riser 51.5 (spout into the shout), thud 69.3 (tail slap), whoosh 88.6 (swell), blip 108.6 (horse), chime 128.9 (recognition), chime 145.7 (the wonder).
